warnings.message: Local transforms will not affect a skinned mesh.
warnings.explanation: Inherited per-part bind transforms. A1 does not modify mesh nodes, bind matrices, geometry, or skin data; the exact static hash and P4 real-asset regression guard this baseline.

warnings.message: Node with a skinned mesh is not root. Parent transforms will not affect a skinned mesh.
warnings.explanation: Inherited character topology: each authored skinned part remains under its original static wrapper. A1 static structure and binary-prefix hashes are exact before/after, and P4 batching relies on these wrappers.
